gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Provisional Estimates of GDP for Q4 FY2025-26 (Jan–Mar 2026) and PE for FY2025-26, press release dated June 5, 2026. Q4 real GDP grew 7.8% YoY, a moderation from Q3 FY26's ~8% (revised); full-year FY26 at 7.7% vs 7.1% in FY25.

cpi.source: MoSPI Consumer Price Index Press Release for June 2026 (base year 2024), released July 13, 2026. All-India CPI inflation 4.38% YoY (provisional), up from 3.93% in May — a six-month high, driven by food inflation (CFPI 5.32%) amid a rainfall deficit.

gsec10y.source: Market yield data (TradingEconomics/interbank OTC quotes) for the 10Y G-Sec benchmark: yield rose from ~6.73% in early July to ~6.81% by July 31, 2026, as higher US Treasury yields following the Fed's policy decision reduced appeal of EM debt.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held repo rate at 5.25% at its June 2026 meeting (third consecutive hold; neutral stance). The next MPC meeting is scheduled Aug 3–5, 2026 (after this refresh's cutoff); a Reuters poll of 72 economists showed 68 expecting another hold, none expecting a cut.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, June 5, 2026 (repo held at 5.25%, neutral stance); Reuters economist poll ahead of Aug 2026 MPC (via NewsX/IndianPayCalculator coverage).

gov_capex.note: CPSEs met 25% of their FY27 cumulative capex target in Q1 (Apr–Jun 2026), with capex up 26% YoY to ₹2.10 lakh crore led by Railways and NHAI — confirming the capex push remains active, though state-level capex utilisation (1.85% in April) started slower than last year.
gov_capex.source: Business Standard — 'CPSEs meet 25% of FY27 cumulative capital expenditure target in Q1' (July 6, 2026); Business Standard — 'States see slower FY27 start, capex utilisation at 1.85% in April' (June 11, 2026).

china_plus_one.note: India's electronics output has grown nearly sixfold in a decade (₹1.9L cr FY15 → ₹11.3L cr FY25) and India overtook China as the top smartphone supplier to the US in Q2 FY26 — supply-chain diversification remains a live tailwind, even as Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal (Jun 2026) argued India no longer needs to lean on the 'China+1' framing to attract investment.
china_plus_one.source: IANS/India Tribune — 'India's electronics output surges sixfold in a decade over policy reforms' (July 15, 2026); BusinessToday — Piyush Goyal on China+1 (June 12, 2026).

rural_recovery.note: Kharif sowing is recovering but still ~6% below last year's pace as of July 17; cumulative Jun 1–Jul 15 rainfall ran 23% below the Long Period Average, with East/Northeast (-36%) and South Peninsula (-26%) hit hardest. Pulses (-15%), coarse cereals (-11%), cotton and oilseeds still lag; paddy has nearly closed the gap on recent rain.
rural_recovery.source: BusinessToday — 'Kharif sowing gains pace despite weak monsoon, recovery uneven across crops' (July 21, 2026); IMD Jun 1–Jul 15 rainfall data.

put_call_ratio.source: NSE Nifty 50 option chain aggregate (total Put OI / total Call OI) via NiftyTrader, as of July 31, 2026. PCR ≈ 1.4883 — put OI exceeds call OI, indicating relatively higher put positioning.
